definition_threshold: TSA < Q1 (< 787 pax/hr) or Sched Flights < Q1 (< 240/day)
key_operational_behavior: Smooth flow; ample runway capacity; 50% of flights push back early; cancellations rare.

definition_threshold: TSA Q1-Q3 (788-3479 pax/hr) or Sched Flights Q1-Q3
key_operational_behavior: Nominal operations; steady passenger flows; manageable tarmac queues; balanced carrier banks.

definition_threshold: TSA Q3-P95 (3480-5330 pax/hr) or Sched Flights >= Q3
key_operational_behavior: +74.5% flight volume growth vs off-peak; delays rise by only 7.4 min; airlines absorb volume smoothly.

definition_threshold: Cancel Rate >= 5.0% OR Mean Dep Delay >= 30.0 min (or TSA > P95)
key_operational_behavior: Non-linear phase transition; cancellations jump 20-fold; departure delays triple; ground delay programs.
